comparison.objective: Press two opposite-sense drawer release levers while pulling the drawer out; candidate releases one terminal retainer and withdraws the terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual simultaneous lever actuation and bulky drawer extraction versus connector-specific fine-tool access and damage-sensitive small-part withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Both levers pressed together, drawer fully removed, stable, and released versus correct terminal and housing reusable with adjacent contacts retained.
comparison.reason: Both are release-and-extract tasks, but simultaneous dual-lever actuation and large slide removal constitute a meaningfully different tested coordination ability. Candidate numeric damage limits remain missing.
